The incoming handoff named C and D. I did not follow it, because the code points to B (dogwhistle/heldout.py). All four ref files contain the same generic text and give no file-specific priority, so the choice rests on a grep of dogwhistle/.

- **heldout.py (B):** the validator is around lines 90-113. Line 90 checks the registration tuple (public_seed, instances_per_cell, protocol_version) against (20261024, 30, "2.0"). Line 92 regenerates the instances from seed 20261024 with 30 instances. Line 100 requires 30 ids. Line 113 requires 180 unique trials. `prepare()` at line 54 also hardcodes the seed and instance count. Lines 259, 385 and 452 repeat the 180 and 30 checks.
- **honest.py (D):** a secondary comparison file. It sets INSTANCES = 30 but has no 20261024 seed and no 180-trial check.
- **study.py (A) and visibility.py (C):** neither has the seed or the 180 check. visibility.py only sets INSTANCES = 30. I did not read study.py in detail.

Suggested 60-minute split:
- B (heldout.py): 40 minutes
- D (honest.py): 8 minutes
- C (visibility.py): 7 minutes
- A (study.py): 5 minutes
